name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Strawberry Cough + White Gushers
description:
Fresh strawberry sweetness meets smooth, candy-forward flavor in this crowd-pleasing pairing. Enjoy the bright berry notes of Strawberry Cough or switch to the creamy, fruity burst of White Gushers.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
